description: DAO-ID: a TableDef R and its Field A are held while the table is renamed through TableDef.Name, dropped by SQL, recreated by SQL under the same name, and found again after TableDefs.Refresh. Name and Fields.Count of each held object are read after every step. Then the recreated table is deleted through TableDefs.Delete inside a Workspace transaction and rolled back, and the held reference is read before and after the rollback and after Refresh.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
